name: Mumbai
description: Mumbai is India's largest city and financial capital, a dense, energetic metropolis on the Arabian Sea known for Bollywood, colonial-era architecture, and a thriving street-food culture. It blends historic landmarks like the Gateway of India with modern skyscrapers and one of the world's busiest waterfronts.
highlights: Gateway of India and the nearby Colaba waterfront
Elephanta Caves (boat trip from Mumbai harbour)
Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (UNESCO World Heritage railway station)
Street food tour in Mohammed Ali Road / Bhendi Bazaar
best_time_to_visit: November to February, when the weather is cooler and dry (monsoon runs roughly June-September).

name: Delhi
description: Delhi, India's capital, layers Mughal-era monuments, British colonial architecture, and a fast-growing modern city across Old and New Delhi. It's home to multiple UNESCO World Heritage Sites within a compact area.
highlights: Red Fort and Chandni Chowk in Old Delhi
India Gate and the government buildings of New Delhi
best_time_to_visit: October to March, avoiding the intense summer heat and monsoon humidity.

name: Bangalore
description: Bangalore is India's tech capital, known for a mild climate, a thriving startup and IT scene, and a mix of colonial-era gardens with a booming pub and restaurant culture. It's a common gateway to South India's hill stations.
highlights: MG Road and Brigade Road shopping/dining district
best_time_to_visit: Bangalore has a pleasant climate year-round; October to February is coolest and driest.

name: Goa
description: Goa is India's smallest state, a former Portuguese colony on the west coast famous for its beaches, laid-back nightlife, and a distinct Indo-Portuguese culture visible in its churches and architecture.
highlights: Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral in Old Goa
best_time_to_visit: November to February, the cool, dry peak season (monsoon runs June-September and many beach shacks close).

name: Palolem Beach, Goa
description: Palolem is a crescent-shaped, palm-lined beach in South Goa known for a calmer, more laid-back atmosphere than the busier beaches of North Goa, with beach huts and kayak/dolphin-watching trips.
highlights: Sunset kayaking or dolphin-spotting boat trips
Beach hut stays directly on the sand
best_time_to_visit: November to April/early May, the peak season when beach huts and silent-disco events are open; nearly all close for the June-September monsoon.

name: Baga Beach, Goa
description: Baga is one of North Goa's busiest and most popular beaches, known for its nightlife, water sports, and beachside shacks and clubs.
highlights: Water sports (parasailing, jet-skiing, banana boat rides)
best_time_to_visit: November to February, peak tourist season.

name: Jaipur
description: Jaipur, the "Pink City," is Rajasthan's capital, famous for its rose-hued old town, Mughal-Rajput palaces and forts, and its role as a gateway to Rajasthan's desert circuit.
highlights: Johari Bazaar for jewellery and textiles
best_time_to_visit: October to March, avoiding Rajasthan's very hot summers.
needs_verification: Current entry fees for City Palace, Jantar Mantar, and Nahargarh Fort

name: Hawa Mahal, Jaipur

Climbing inside for views over Jaipur's old city
Combining with a City Palace/Jantar Mantar visit (all close together)
best_time_to_visit: Early morning for the best light on the facade and fewer crowds; open daily roughly 9am-5pm, October to March overall.

Amer Fort's evening light-and-sound show (around Rs.295, ~50 minutes, in Hindi and English; showtime shifts with the season)

The inlaid marble (pietra dura) detailing up close
Photographing from across the Yamuna at Mehtab Bagh
Closed every Friday - entry that day is restricted to those attending prayers at the on-site mosque

name: Udaipur
description: Udaipur, the "City of Lakes," is a Rajasthan city built around artificial lakes and known for its palaces, many of which sit on or beside the water, giving it a romantic reputation.

Saheliyon ki Bari (Garden of the Maidens)
best_time_to_visit: September to March, when lake levels and weather are most pleasant.

name: Jodhpur

best_time_to_visit: October to March, avoiding the desert heat of summer.

name: Jaisalmer

Patwon ki Haveli and other carved havelis
Camel safari and overnight desert camping at Sam Sand Dunes

name: Manali
description: Manali is a Himalayan hill town in Himachal Pradesh, popular for mountain scenery, adventure sports, and as a gateway to high-altitude passes like Rohtang and the Leh-Manali highway.

best_time_to_visit: March to June and September to November; roads to high passes are typically snowbound in deep winter.

name: Shimla
description: Shimla, the former summer capital of British India, is a Himalayan hill station known for colonial-era architecture, pine forests, and the pedestrian Mall Road at its centre.

Jakhu Temple and hilltop Hanuman statue
best_time_to_visit: March to June for pleasant weather, or December to February for snow.

name: Dharamshala
description: Dharamshala is a Himachal Pradesh hill town best known as the seat of the Tibetan government-in-exile and the residence of the Dalai Lama, set against snow-capped Dhauladhar mountain views.
highlights: Namgyal Monastery and the Dalai Lama's temple complex
Triund trek (day hike with Himalayan views)
best_time_to_visit: March to June and September to November; monsoon (July-August) brings heavy rain.

description: McLeod Ganj is the upper part of Dharamshala, a small town with a large Tibetan exile community, monasteries, and cafes, often used as a base for the Triund trek.

name: Leh, Ladakh
description: Leh is the main town of Ladakh, a high-altitude desert region in the Himalayas known for Buddhist monasteries, dramatic mountain-and-lake landscapes, and some of the highest motorable passes in the world.
highlights: Nubra Valley and its sand dunes
best_time_to_visit: May to September, when high-altitude roads are open; the region is snowbound and largely inaccessible by road in winter.

name: Srinagar

Old Srinagar's Jama Masjid and shrines
best_time_to_visit: April to October; winters are cold with occasional snow.

name: Rishikesh
description: Rishikesh, on the banks of the Ganges in Uttarakhand, is known as a centre for yoga and meditation, and has become a popular base for river rafting and other Himalayan adventure activities.

Laxman Jhula and Ram Jhula suspension bridges
best_time_to_visit: September to April; rafting season typically runs September/October to June, pausing during peak monsoon.
needs_verification: Current rafting-season dates and permit rules, which are set annually by local authorities

name: Haridwar
description: Haridwar is one of Hinduism's seven holiest cities, sitting where the Ganges leaves the Himalayan foothills, and is best known for its evening Ganga Aarti and as a periodic host of the Kumbh Mela.

Mansa Devi Temple (reachable by cable car)

name: Varanasi
description: Varanasi, on the banks of the Ganges, is one of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities and a major pilgrimage site for Hindus, known for its ghats and cremation rituals performed in public view.

Ganga Aarti ceremony at Dashashwamedh Ghat
Sarnath (Buddhist site, short trip from Varanasi)

name: Kerala
description: Kerala, on India's tropical southwest coast, is known for its backwaters, houseboats, tea and spice plantations, and Ayurvedic wellness tourism, often marketed as "God's Own Country."
best_time_to_visit: September to March, avoiding the monsoon (June-August), though monsoon season is itself popular for Ayurvedic treatments.

name: Munnar, Kerala
description: Munnar is a hill station in Kerala's Western Ghats known for its rolling tea plantations, cool climate, and the endangered Nilgiri tahr found in nearby Eravikulam National Park.

name: Alleppey, Kerala

Kuttanad's paddy fields below sea level

Mattancherry Palace and Jew Town/Paradesi Synagogue
best_time_to_visit: October to March, avoiding monsoon season.

name: Ooty

highlights: Nilgiri Mountain Railway (UNESCO World Heritage toy train)
best_time_to_visit: April to June and September to November; can get cold December-February.

name: Coorg
description: Coorg (Kodagu) is a hilly district in Karnataka known as the "Scotland of India," famous for coffee plantations, spice estates, and misty Western Ghats scenery.
best_time_to_visit: October to March, dry and cool; monsoon (June-September) is scenic but very wet.

name: Mysore
description: Mysore (Mysuru) is a Karnataka city known for its opulent Mysore Palace and its lavish Dasara festival celebrations, alongside a legacy as a former princely-state capital.

best_time_to_visit: October (for Dasara festival) or generally October to February for cooler weather.

name: Chennai
description: Chennai, the capital of Tamil Nadu, is a major South Indian cultural and economic hub on the Bay of Bengal, known for Dravidian temple architecture, classical dance, and one of India's longest urban beaches.
best_time_to_visit: November to February, avoiding intense heat and humidity.

name: Pondicherry
description: Pondicherry (Puducherry) is a former French colonial territory on India's southeast coast, known for its French Quarter's colourful colonial buildings, seaside promenade, and the Auroville experimental community nearby.
best_time_to_visit: October to March, avoiding summer heat and monsoon.

name: Hyderabad
description: Hyderabad is the capital of Telangana, a city that blends Deccani and Mughal-influenced heritage (from the Qutb Shahi and Nizam eras) with a major modern IT industry, and is famous for its biryani.

Hussain Sagar lake and Buddha statue
best_time_to_visit: October to February, avoiding the hot summer months.

name: Kolkata
description: Kolkata (Calcutta), the capital of West Bengal and former capital of British India, is known for its colonial-era architecture, literary and artistic heritage, and a strong cultural identity centred on the Bengali arts.

best_time_to_visit: October to March, avoiding summer heat and monsoon humidity; Durga Puja (September/October) is a major cultural event.

name: Darjeeling

Tiger Hill sunrise view of Kanchenjunga

Limestone caves and mud volcanoes, Baratang Island

name: Hong Kong
description: Hong Kong is a dense harbour city known for its skyline, a blend of Cantonese and British colonial influences, and easy contrasts between ultra-urban districts and nearby hiking trails and islands.
highlights: Big Buddha and Po Lin Monastery, Lantau Island
best_time_to_visit: October to December, mild and dry; avoid the humid summer typhoon season (roughly June-September).
needs_verification: Current visa-free entry duration/requirements for your nationality
